entries.zh: 綜来；把头发束拢收起（arrebatardello cabello＝收束头发，西语栏字形难辨）
entries.en: to tie up / gather up the hair
entries.notes: 西语栏含难辨拼写（arrebatardello），以 R 栏 chǒng-dāy 与汉字綜、来（收拢而来）推断为束发义。

entries.zh: 夺；抢夺
entries.en: to snatch, to seize forcibly

entries.zh: 夺搥；夺走弯曲的棍棒（西语栏难辨：抢走曲杖、棍棒之类）
entries.en: to snatch the curved club / stick away
entries.notes: 西语栏 palo curvo 一段标注难辨，据汉字搥（锤、棒）与 palo curvo 推断。

entries.zh: 夺带；连腰带一起夺走（西语栏难辨：连身佩带之物一并夺去）
entries.en: to snatch away together with what is worn / carried on the person
entries.notes: 西语栏难辨；汉字夺带、对音 tōa（带）指随身佩带，推断为连带夺走。

entries.zh: 夺来；抢夺后拿走（arrebatalos y traerlos＝夺走并带走）
entries.en: to snatch and carry off

entries.zh: 夺去哪；夺到哪里去（arrebatalos y mete＝夺走放入/带往某处；R 栏后两字污损难辨）
entries.en: to snatch away and take off to (a place)
entries.notes: R 栏 güi ek 项两枚声调记号标 T99 污损难辨，M 栏 cù nió（去哪）与西语 mete 衔接不完整，释义存疑。

entries.zh: 夺走；抢了就跑（arrebatalos y huie＝夺走而逃）
entries.en: to snatch and run away (with it)

entries.zh: 劫；以强力抢夺
entries.en: to rob by force, to plunder

entries.zh: 劫剥人；剥人衣物、劫掠人身（arrebatan el vestido＝夺其衣服）
entries.en: to strip a person (of clothing), to plunder someone

entries.zh: 搶；抢掠
entries.en: to snatch, to grab, to plunder

entries.zh: 搶四散；抢夺而四散奔逃（西语栏难辨：抢了各处逃散）
entries.en: to snatch and scatter in flight
entries.notes: 西语栏 anparun 标注难辨，据汉字四散与对音 sí-soá 推断为抢后散逃。

entries.zh: 搶走去；抢了跑去（arrebatan y huie＝抢夺而逃）
entries.en: to snatch and run off

entries.zh: 搶平宜；抢购贱价货（arrebatan la hacienda comprandola mas barata＝争购最便宜的货物）
entries.en: to snap up goods by buying them cheap
entries.notes: 平宜＝便宜，马尼拉贸易语境下的抢购贱货义。

entries.zh: 搶錢虎；抢钱的虎（喻强夺钱财者；西语栏 vintige 难辨）
entries.en: money-snatching tiger; a rapacious robber of money
entries.notes: 西语栏 como vintige 难辨；据汉字錢虎（虎喻凶狠掠夺者）推断为喻指劫财者。

entries.zh: 搶賊；抢掠之贼（arrebatan, hurtar＝抢、偷窃）
entries.en: robbing thief; to snatch and steal

entries.zh: 搶嫁；强抢（女子）成婚（西语栏 aonsla 难辨：强掳妇人妻室）
entries.en: to abduct a woman for marriage, to carry off (a wife) by force
entries.notes: 西语栏 muger（妇人）与 aonsla 难辨；据汉字嫁与 muger 推断为抢婚义。

entries.zh: 搶奪；抢夺（arrebatan y tomarselo＝抢而据为己有）
entries.en: to seize and take for oneself

entries.zh: 搶剥；抢夺剥取（西语栏难辨：抢走、剥取其物）
entries.en: to snatch and strip (goods from someone)
entries.notes: 西语栏 envelas nagnus 一段难辨；据汉字搶剥推断为连抢带剥之义。

entries.zh: 占；强占（arrebatan por fuerza＝以强力占据）
entries.en: to seize, to occupy (by force)

entries.zh: 占位；占据位分、夺其位（quitarle el lugar o dignidad＝夺其职位或尊严）
entries.en: to take someone's place or dignity, to usurp a position

entries.zh: 占處；占据处所（西语栏难辨：占其地方）
entries.en: to occupy a place, to take possession of a spot
entries.notes: 西语栏 qui talbell yan 难辨；据汉字處与对音 chì 推断为占据处所义。

entries.zh: 剥；剥取、掠夺
entries.en: to strip, to fleece, to plunder

entries.zh: 剥劫；剥掠劫夺（西语栏 nabatina 难辨）
entries.en: to strip and plunder
entries.notes: 西语栏 nabatina 难辨；据汉字剥劫二义相并推断。

entries.zh: 剥銀；劫掠银钱（saltear＝拦路抢劫）
entries.en: to rob (someone) of silver / money
